summary: Iteration 6 fully validated end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (backend_iteration6_test.py). (A) Clients: POST/PATCH/GET/DELETE all persist the new fields (photo_base64, icon, date_of_birth, sex, condition, severity, medications, behaviours) with correct defaults (icon='person', color='#00E5FF', all new strings default ''); DELETE removes and subsequent GET returns 404. (B) Expenses CRUD: POST returns full expense with created_at; GET /api/expenses sorts by due_date ASC verified with 3 seeded records (Early < Mid < Late); PATCH updates cost/direct_debit/category/renewal_date; DELETE removes; PATCH on missing id returns 404. (C) Dashboard: GET /api/dashboard/outstanding returns unpaid invoices enriched with invoice_number, total, sent_date, days_since_sent (int, >=0 after mark-sent), client_name, client_initials (two-token '?TO' verified + fallback '?' when no name), client_color (from client doc + fallback #00E5FF), shift_date, due_date; paid invoices correctly excluded. Regression: invoice totals (3×67.56 → subtotal 202.68/gst 20.27/total 222.95), receipt create+list, dashboard stats shape (12 required keys), and Credentials number field COC-2026-XYZ-9982 persists on POST + list. Frontend (390×844): Command screen — metric-outstanding taps expand outstanding-dropdown showing outstanding-{id} rows with SM initials badge, invoice number, days since sent, shift date, $ owing (screenshots confirm INV-1003 '0d since sent · shift 2026-07-03' and INV-1001 '1d since sent · $222.95 owing'). ministat-expenses tap navigates to /vault (URL confirmed). Vault — Total expenses $42.50, seg-receipts / seg-bills / seg-calendar segments all present and switchable; Bills & Costs empty-state with 'No costs yet' + '+' FAB visible; Calendar renders month grid with Sun-Sat header, legend dots (Receipts/Bill due/Renewal), tapping day shows 'Nothing scheduled on this day'. Clients form (ClientFormSheet) — icon picker (9 icons: icon-person/happy/heart/accessibility/walk/body/medkit/star/paw/home), colour picker (8 swatches: color-#00E5FF etc), Snap/Upload photo (client-photo-camera, client-photo-upload), all care-profile fields present (client-name, client-dob, sex-Male/Female/Other, client-condition, Mild/Moderate/Severe chips, client-medications, client-behaviours, client-ndis/company/email/phone/address/plan-manager, save-client-btn). Credentials — cred-number field present in add form. Only harmless RN-web deprecation warnings observed (shadow*, pointerEvents, Image tintColor) and expo-notifications web limitation — no pageerrors, no red screens.

minor.issue: days_since_sent uses today.date() minus sent_date; if sent_date is somehow in the future (e.g. clock skew or manual edit) the value would be negative. Consider max(0, delta) or return null for future dates.

Body is accepted as raw dict without any Pydantic validation — a client could set arbitrary keys (e.g. injected 'foo': 'bar') and they'll be stored. Non-blocking (single-user mode) but consider ExpensePatch model to whitelist keys.
Returns {success: true} even when the id doesn't exist (no 404). Non-blocking; consistent with other resources but arguably incorrect.

Loads ALL clients (up to 2000) and ALL shifts (up to 2000) into memory on every call to build lookup dicts. Fine at current scale; consider $lookup or targeted queries only for the client_ids/shift_ids that actually appear in unpaid invoices when data grows.

issues: Empty state 'No costs yet. Add bills, direct debits & subscriptions.' is clear but the FAB (+) doesn't have an obvious testID discoverable via 'fab/add/expense/bill/cost' search. Consider adding testID='add-expense-fab' for reliable automation.

Row shows '0d since sent · shift 2026-07-03' and '$0.00 owing' for INV-1003 (draft-like unpaid) — an amount of $0.00 owing is a bit noisy in the dropdown. Consider hiding rows where total==0, or showing 'draft' badge instead.

Severity chips (Mild/Moderate/Severe) do not carry an obvious testID matching 'sev-*' pattern (couldn't find sev-Mild / sev-Moderate / sev-Severe). They render fine visually but hard to target in tests — add testID='sev-Mild' etc for stability.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking, carried from prior iterations.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Non-blocking, carried from prior iterations.

'Image: style.tintColor is deprecated. Please use props.tintColor.' Appears when navigating into the Vault Calendar segment (react-native-calendars renders an <Image> with tintColor in style). Non-blocking — likely inside the third-party library.
'[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' Web-preview only limitation; harmless on native builds.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add testID='add-expense-fab' to the Vault FAB and testID='sev-Mild' | 'sev-Moderate' | 'sev-Severe' to the severity chips in ClientFormSheet — makes future automation more reliable.
(Optional) In /api/dashboard/outstanding, clamp days_since_sent to max(0, delta) or return null if sent_date is in the future.
(Optional) Consider hiding zero-total unpaid invoices from the Outstanding dropdown, or badge them as 'draft' — INV-1003 currently shows '$0.00 owing' which is visually noisy.
(Optional) Introduce an ExpensePatch Pydantic model for PATCH /api/expenses/{id} to whitelist mutable keys instead of accepting raw dict.
(Optional cleanup carried from iter-5) The NDIS_CODES module-level constant at server.py:183-194 is still dead code; safe to remove.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — ClientCreate/Client models correctly include all new profile fields with sensible defaults; PATCH /clients/{id} strips 'id'/'_id' before $set which prevents accidental primary-key mutation.

server.py — Expense/ExpenseCreate models are clean; POST /expenses uses model_dump(exclude={'id'}) to avoid leaking None id into Mongo. List endpoint sorts by due_date ASC — correct for a 'what's coming up' list.

server.py — /api/dashboard/outstanding correctly filters by status:'unpaid', enriches with client_name/initials/color from the clients collection, and derives shift_date from shifts.started_at[:10]. Fallback client_color='#00E5FF' matches the client Model default so the UI stays consistent.

frontend/app/(tabs)/clients.tsx — long-press opens Alert with Open profile / Edit / Delete; short-press navigates; menu ellipsis also triggers openActions. ClientFormSheet passed initial={editing} for edit mode. Age is derived client-side via ageFromDob() and rendered in the subtitle.

frontend/app/client/[id].tsx — Care Profile section only renders when at least one field is set (guards on condition/severity/medications/behaviours), preventing an empty section for legacy clients. Severity pill colour maps Severe→error / Moderate→warning / Mild→success. Header has edit-client-btn and delete-client-btn with proper Alert-based delete confirmation that router.back()s on success.

frontend/app/vault.tsx (implied) — segment toggle testIDs seg-receipts/seg-bills/seg-calendar all present and functional; Calendar uses react-native-calendars with dot legend for receipts/bills/renewals. Confirmed working on 390×844 web preview.

frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx — metric-outstanding is a Pressable that toggles outstanding-dropdown; each row uses outstanding-{id} testID with initials avatar, invoice number/name, days_since_sent, shift date, and amount owing. ministat-expenses is a Pressable that router.push('/vault'). Confirmed via live navigation.
PATCH /clients & /expenses & /credentials do not use try/except around ObjectId(id) — malformed 24-hex IDs still yield 500. Carried from prior iterations, non-blocking.
